question: What is the average Relative percentile for Theme 1 (Socioeconomic) for census tracts in Texas (STATEFP 48) that intersect a FEMA floodplain polygon?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(v.RPL_THEME1) AS avg_theme1_rank FROM svi v JOIN census_tracts t ON v.GEOID = t.GEOID JOIN floodplain f ON ST_Intersects(t.geometry, f.geometry) WHERE t.STATEFP='48' AND ST_IsValid(t.geometry) AND ST_IsValid(f.geometry) AND v.RPL_THEME1 IS NOT NULL AND v.RPL_THEME1 BETWEEN 0 AND 100;
sql: SELECT AVG(v.RPL_THEME1) AS avg_theme1_rank FROM svi AS v JOIN census_tracts AS t ON v.GEOID = t.GEOID JOIN floodplain AS f ON ST_OVERLAPS(t.geometry, f.geometry) WHERE t.STATEFP = '48' AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry) AND NOT v.RPL_THEME1 IS NULL AND v.RPL_THEME1 BETWEEN 0 AND 100

question: Which 5 Florida (STATEFP 12) counties have the highest number of hospitals located inside floodplain zones? Return their names.

sql: SELECT AVG(s.SPL_THEME1) AS avg_svi_theme1 FROM hospitals AS h JOIN census_tracts AS t ON ST_CONTAINS(t.geometry, ST_POINT(h.LAT, h.LON)) JOIN svi AS s ON t.GEOID = s.GEOID WHERE h.STATEFP = '12' AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry) AND NOT s.SPL_THEME1 IS NULL AND s.SPL_THEME1 BETWEEN 0 AND 100

question: Among Florida counties (STATEFP 12), which has the greatest number of low-resilience tracts (percentage of individuals with zero components of social vulnerability lower than 10) that intersect FEMA floodplain areas? Return its county name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.NAME AS county_name FROM cre r JOIN census_tracts t ON r.GEOID=t.GEOID JOIN county c ON LEFT(t.GEOID,5)=c.GEOID JOIN floodplain f ON ST_Intersects(t.geometry,f.geometry) WHERE c.STATEFP='12' AND r.PRED0_PE<10 AND r.PRED0_PE BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND ST_IsValid(f.geometry) AND ST_IsValid(t.geometry) GROUP BY c.NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
sql: SELECT c.NAME AS county_name FROM cre AS r JOIN census_tracts AS t ON r.GEOID = t.GEOID JOIN county AS c ON LEFT(t.GEOID, 5) = c.GEOID JOIN floodplain AS f ON ST_OVERLAPS(t.geometry, f.geometry) WHERE c.STATEFP = '12' AND r.PRED0_PE < 10 AND r.PRED0_PE BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry) GROUP BY c.NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: In Louisiana (STATEFP 22), what is the maximum Insurance payout amount (in USD) for structural building damage (amountPaidOnContentsClaim) across all census tracts that contain at least one hospital?

sql: SELECT c.NAME AS county_name FROM nri AS n JOIN census_tracts AS t ON n.GEOID = t.GEOID JOIN county AS c ON LEFT(t.GEOID, 5) = c.GEOID JOIN floodplain AS f ON ST_CONTAINS(f.geometry, t.geometry) WHERE c.STATEFP = '48' AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry) GROUP BY c.NAME ORDER BY SUM(n.RFLD_EALB) DESC LIMIT 1

question: In Orleans Parish, Louisiana (GEOID prefix 22071), what is the average Underlying continuous numeric riverine flood risk value used to derive the categorical rating and normalized score for all census tracts that intersect FEMA floodplain polygons?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(n.RFLD_RISKV) AS avg_riverine_risk FROM census_tracts t JOIN floodplain f ON ST_Intersects(t.geometry, f.geometry) JOIN nri n ON t.GEOID = n.GEOID WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID, 5) = '22071' AND ST_IsValid(t.geometry) AND ST_IsValid(f.geometry) AND n.RFLD_RISKV IS NOT NULL;
sql: SELECT AVG(n.RFLD_RISKV) AS avg_riverine_risk FROM census_tracts AS t JOIN floodplain AS f ON ST_OVERLAPS(t.geometry, f.geometry) JOIN nri AS n ON t.GEOID = n.GEOID WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID, 5) = '22071' AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry) AND NOT n.RFLD_RISKV IS NULL

question: In Louisiana (STATEFP 22), which 2 counties have the most schools located inside both FEMA floodplain and ZCTA polygons? Return their county names.
gold_sql: SELECT c.NAME AS county_name FROM schools s JOIN county c ON c.STATEFP='22' AND ST_Contains(c.geometry, ST_Point(s.LON, s.LAT)) WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM zcta z JOIN floodplain f ON ST_Intersects(f.geometry, z.geometry) WHERE ST_Contains(z.geometry, ST_Point(s.LON, s.LAT)) AND ST_IsValid(f.geometry) AND ST_IsValid(z.geometry)) AND ST_IsValid(c.geometry) GROUP BY c.NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 2;
sql: SELECT c.NAME AS county_name FROM schools AS s JOIN county AS c ON c.STATEFP = '22' AND ST_TOUCHES(c.geometry, ST_POINT(s.LON, s.LAT)) WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM zcta AS z JOIN floodplain AS f ON ST_INTERSECTS(f.geometry, z.geometry) WHERE ST_CONTAINS(z.geometry, ST_POINT(s.LON, s.LAT)) AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(z.geometry)) AND ST_ISVALID(c.geometry) GROUP BY c.NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 2

sql: SELECT SUM(CAST(l.amountPaidOnBuildingClaim AS DOUBLE)) AS total_claims_paid FROM hospitals AS h JOIN county AS c ON ST_CONTAINS(c.geometry, ST_POINT(h.LAT, h.LON)) JOIN claims AS l ON LEFT(l.GEOID, 5) = c.GEOID WHERE c.GEOID = '48453' AND ST_ISVALID(c.geometry) AND NOT l.amountPaidOnBuildingClaim IS NULL

question: In Orleans Parish (Louisiana, GEOID 22071), how many census tracts have NFIP claims and intersect any FEMA floodplain polygons?

question: In Jefferson Parish, Louisiana (GEOID 22051), what is the total Insurance payout amount (in USD) for structural building damage for all NFIP flood claims recorded in that county, contingent on the county boundary also containing at least one hospital?

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.GEOID) AS num_tracts FROM census_tracts AS t WHERE t.GEOID = '48113' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM claims AS cl WHERE cl.GEOID = t.GEOID) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM floodplain AS f WHERE ST_INTERSECTS(t.geometry, f.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry))

sql: SELECT AVG(sub.RFLD_EALB) AS avg_building_loss FROM (SELECT DISTINCT n.GEOID, n.RFLD_EALB FROM nri AS n JOIN census_tracts AS t ON n.GEOID = t.GEOID JOIN floodplain AS f ON ST_INTERSECTS(f.geometry, t.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID, 5) = '48' AND n.RFLD_EALB BETWEEN 0 AND 1e9 AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry)) AS sub

question: What is the total area where census tract geometries and FEMA floodplain polygons intersect, considering only tracts that also intersect ZCTA boundaries, in Dallas County, Texas (identified by the leftmost 5 digits of GEOID 48113 in the census_tract table)?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(ST_Area(ST_Intersection(t.geometry, f.geometry))) AS total_overlap_area FROM census_tracts t JOIN floodplain f ON ST_Intersects(t.geometry, f.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID,5)='48113' AND t.GEOID IN (SELECT DISTINCT t2.GEOID FROM census_tracts t2 JOIN zcta z ON ST_Intersects(t2.geometry, z.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t2.GEOID,5)='48113' AND ST_IsValid(t2.geometry) AND ST_IsValid(z.geometry)) AND ST_IsValid(t.geometry) AND ST_IsValid(f.geometry);
sql: SELECT SUM(ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.geometry, f.geometry))) AS total_overlap_area FROM census_tracts AS t JOIN floodplain AS f ON ST_OVERLAPS(t.geometry, f.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID, 5) = '48113' AND t.GEOID IN (SELECT DISTINCT t2.GEOID FROM census_tracts AS t2 JOIN zcta AS z ON ST_INTERSECTS(t2.geometry, z.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t2.GEOID, 5) = '48113' AND ST_ISVALID(t2.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(z.geometry)) AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry)

sql: SELECT SUM(ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.geometry, f.geometry))) AS total_overlap_area FROM census_tracts AS t JOIN floodplain AS f ON ST_INTERSECTS(t.geometry, f.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID, 5) = '48113' AND t.GEOID IN (SELECT DISTINCT t2.GEOID FROM census_tracts AS t2 JOIN zcta AS z ON ST_INTERSECTS(t2.geometry, z.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t2.GEOID, 5) = '48998' AND ST_ISVALID(t2.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(z.geometry)) AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry)

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.UNIQUE_ID) AS num_schools FROM schools AS s JOIN census_tracts AS t ON ST_WITHIN(ST_POINT(s.LON, s.LAT), t.geometry) JOIN floodplain AS f ON ST_WITHIN(ST_POINT(s.LON, s.LAT), f.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID, 2) = '12086' AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry)

question: What is the total area where FEMA floodplain polygons intersect census tract geometries, considering only tracts that also intersect ZCTA boundaries, in Harris County, Texas (identified by the leftmost 5 digits of GEOID 48201 in the census_tract table)?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(ST_Area(ST_Intersection(f.geometry, t.geometry))) AS total_overlap_area FROM floodplain f JOIN census_tracts t ON ST_Intersects(f.geometry, t.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID,5)='48201' AND t.GEOID IN (SELECT DISTINCT t2.GEOID FROM census_tracts t2 JOIN zcta z ON ST_Intersects(t2.geometry, z.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t2.GEOID,5)='48201' AND ST_IsValid(t2.geometry) AND ST_IsValid(z.geometry)) AND ST_IsValid(f.geometry) AND ST_IsValid(t.geometry);
sql: SELECT SUM(ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(f.geometry, t.geometry))) AS total_overlap_area FROM floodplain AS f JOIN census_tracts AS t ON ST_OVERLAPS(f.geometry, t.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID, 5) = '48201' AND t.GEOID IN (SELECT DISTINCT t2.GEOID FROM census_tracts AS t2 JOIN zcta AS z ON ST_INTERSECTS(t2.geometry, z.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t2.GEOID, 5) = '48201' AND ST_ISVALID(t2.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(z.geometry)) AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry)

sql: SELECT MAX(ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.geometry, f.geometry))) AS max_overlap_area FROM census_tracts AS t JOIN floodplain AS f ON ST_CONTAINS(t.geometry, f.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID, 5) = '12099' AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry) AND ST_AREA(t.geometry) > 0 AND t.GEOID IN (SELECT DISTINCT t2.GEOID FROM census_tracts AS t2 JOIN zcta AS z ON ST_INTERSECTS(t2.geometry, z.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t2.GEOID, 5) = '12099' AND ST_ISVALID(t2.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(z.geometry))

sql: SELECT MAX(ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.geometry, f.geometry))) AS max_overlap_area FROM census_tracts AS t JOIN floodplain AS f ON ST_INTERSECTS(t.geometry, f.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID, 5) = '12099' AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry) AND ST_AREA(t.geometry) > 0 AND t.GEOID IN (SELECT DISTINCT t2.GEOID FROM census_tracts AS t2 JOIN zcta AS z ON ST_INTERSECTS(t2.geometry, z.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t2.GEOID, 2) = '12099' AND ST_ISVALID(t2.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(z.geometry))

question: Among all ZCTAs in the dataset, what percentage share boundaries with census tracts that intersect FEMA floodplain polygons in Orleans Parish, Louisiana (identified by the leftmost 5 digits of GEOID 22071 in the census_tract table)?

gold_sql: SELECT AVG(ST_Area(ST_Intersection(t.geometry, f.geometry))) AS avg_overlap_area FROM census_tracts t JOIN floodplain f ON ST_Overlaps(t.geometry, f.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID,5)='48201' AND ST_IsValid(t.geometry) AND ST_IsValid(f.geometry) AND t.GEOID IN (SELECT DISTINCT t2.GEOID FROM census_tracts t2 JOIN zcta z ON ST_Overlaps(t2.geometry, z.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t2.GEOID,5)='48201' AND ST_IsValid(t2.geometry) AND ST_IsValid(z.geometry));
sql: SELECT AVG(ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.geometry, f.geometry))) AS avg_overlap_area FROM census_tracts AS t JOIN floodplain AS f ON ST_OVERLAPS(t.geometry, f.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID, 5) = '48998' AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry) AND t.GEOID IN (SELECT DISTINCT t2.GEOID FROM census_tracts AS t2 JOIN zcta AS z ON ST_OVERLAPS(t2.geometry, z.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t2.GEOID, 5) = '48201' AND ST_ISVALID(t2.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(z.geometry))

question: Among ZCTAs that intersect FEMA floodplain polygons and also intersect census tract geometries in Travis County, Texas (identified by the leftmost 5 digits of GEOID 48453), what is the maximum number of distinct floodplain polygons intersecting any single ZCTA?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(floodplain_count) AS max_floodplain_per_zcta FROM (SELECT z.GEOID, COUNT(DISTINCT f.GFID) AS floodplain_count FROM zcta z JOIN floodplain f ON ST_Intersects(z.geometry, f.geometry) JOIN census_tracts t ON ST_Intersects(z.geometry, t.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID,5)='48453' AND ST_IsValid(z.geometry) AND ST_IsValid(f.geometry) AND ST_IsValid(t.geometry) GROUP BY z.GEOID);

sql: SELECT SUM(ST_AREA(z.geometry)) AS total_zcta_area FROM zcta AS z JOIN county AS c ON ST_INTERSECTS(z.geometry, c.geometry) WHERE c.GEOID = '12011' AND ST_ISVALID(z.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(c.geometry) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM floodplain AS f WHERE ST_OVERLAPS(z.geometry, f.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry))

question: What is the average percentage of each census tract's total area that intersects FEMA floodplain polygons, considering only tracts that also intersect ZCTA geometries, in Jefferson Parish, Louisiana (identified by the leftmost 5 digits of GEOID 22051 in the census_tract table)?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG((ST_Area(ST_Intersection(t.geometry, f.geometry)) / ST_Area(t.geometry)) * 100) AS avg_overlap_pct FROM census_tracts t JOIN floodplain f ON ST_Intersects(t.geometry, f.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID,5)='22051' AND ST_IsValid(t.geometry) AND ST_IsValid(f.geometry) AND t.GEOID IN (SELECT DISTINCT t2.GEOID FROM census_tracts t2 JOIN zcta z ON ST_Intersects(t2.geometry, z.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t2.GEOID,5)='22051' AND ST_IsValid(t2.geometry) AND ST_IsValid(z.geometry));
sql: SELECT AVG((ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.geometry, f.geometry)) / ST_AREA(t.geometry)) * 100) AS avg_overlap_pct FROM census_tracts AS t JOIN floodplain AS f ON ST_OVERLAPS(t.geometry, f.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID, 5) = '22051' AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry) AND t.GEOID IN (SELECT DISTINCT t2.GEOID FROM census_tracts AS t2 JOIN zcta AS z ON ST_INTERSECTS(t2.geometry, z.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t2.GEOID, 5) = '22051' AND ST_ISVALID(t2.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(z.geometry))

sql: SELECT MIN(floodplain_count) AS min_floodplain_per_tract FROM (SELECT t.GEOID, COUNT(DISTINCT f.GFID) AS floodplain_count FROM census_tracts AS t JOIN floodplain AS f ON ST_INTERSECTS(f.geometry, t.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID, 5) = '48998' AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry) AND t.GEOID IN (SELECT DISTINCT t2.GEOID FROM census_tracts AS t2 JOIN zcta AS z ON ST_INTERSECTS(t2.geometry, z.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t2.GEOID, 5) = '48201' AND ST_ISVALID(t2.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(z.geometry)) GROUP BY t.GEOID)

question: What percentage of census tracts in Dallas County, Texas (identified by the leftmost 5 digits of GEOID 48113 in the census_tract table) intersect both FEMA floodplain polygons and county geometries?

sql: SELECT AVG(school_count) AS avg_schools_per_tract FROM (SELECT t.GEOID, COUNT(DISTINCT s.UNIQUE_ID) AS school_count FROM schools AS s JOIN floodplain AS f ON ST_WITHIN(ST_POINT(s.LON, s.LAT), f.geometry) JOIN census_tracts AS t ON ST_WITHIN(t.geometry, ST_POINT(s.LON, s.LAT)) WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID, 5) = '22071' AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry) GROUP BY t.GEOID)

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.GEOID) AS num_tracts FROM census_tracts AS t JOIN floodplain AS f ON ST_INTERSECTS(t.geometry, f.geometry) JOIN zcta AS z ON ST_TOUCHES(t.geometry, z.geometry) WHERE t.GEOID = '48201' AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(z.geometry)

question: What is the average number of FEMA floodplain polygons located entirely within each ZCTA that intersects census tract geometries in Miami-Dade County, Florida (identified by the leftmost 5 digits of GEOID 12086)?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(floodplain_count) AS avg_floodplain_per_zcta FROM (SELECT z.GEOID, COUNT(DISTINCT f.GFID) AS floodplain_count FROM floodplain f JOIN zcta z ON ST_Within(f.geometry, z.geometry) JOIN census_tracts t ON ST_Intersects(z.geometry, t.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID,5)='12086' AND ST_IsValid(f.geometry) AND ST_IsValid(t.geometry) AND ST_IsValid(z.geometry) GROUP BY z.GEOID);
sql: SELECT AVG(floodplain_count) AS avg_floodplain_per_zcta FROM (SELECT z.GEOID, COUNT(DISTINCT f.GFID) AS floodplain_count FROM floodplain AS f JOIN zcta AS z ON ST_INTERSECTS(f.geometry, z.geometry) JOIN census_tracts AS t ON ST_INTERSECTS(z.geometry, t.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID, 5) = '12086' AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(z.geometry) GROUP BY z.GEOID)

question: What is the average total intersection area between each census tract and FEMA floodplain polygons, considering only tracts that also intersect ZCTA geometries, in Palm Beach County, Florida (identified by the leftmost 5 digits of GEOID 12099 in the census_tract table)?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(overlap_area) AS avg_overlap_area FROM (SELECT t.GEOID, SUM(ST_Area(ST_Intersection(t.geometry, f.geometry))) AS overlap_area FROM census_tracts t JOIN floodplain f ON ST_Intersects(t.geometry, f.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID,5)='12099' AND ST_IsValid(t.geometry) AND ST_IsValid(f.geometry) AND t.GEOID IN (SELECT DISTINCT t2.GEOID FROM census_tracts t2 JOIN zcta z ON ST_Intersects(t2.geometry, z.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t2.GEOID,5)='12099' AND ST_IsValid(t2.geometry) AND ST_IsValid(z.geometry)) GROUP BY t.GEOID);
sql: SELECT AVG(overlap_area) AS avg_overlap_area FROM (SELECT t.GEOID, SUM(ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.geometry, f.geometry))) AS overlap_area FROM census_tracts AS t JOIN floodplain AS f ON ST_OVERLAPS(t.geometry, f.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID, 5) = '12099' AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry) AND t.GEOID IN (SELECT DISTINCT t2.GEOID FROM census_tracts AS t2 JOIN zcta AS z ON ST_INTERSECTS(t2.geometry, z.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t2.GEOID, 5) = '12099' AND ST_ISVALID(t2.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(z.geometry)) GROUP BY t.GEOID)

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.GFID) AS num_floodplain FROM floodplain AS f JOIN census_tracts AS t ON ST_TOUCHES(f.geometry, t.geometry) JOIN county AS c ON ST_INTERSECTS(f.geometry, c.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID, 5) = '48113' AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(c.geometry)

question: What is the maximum number of schools located within any single census tract in Palm Beach County, Florida (identified by the leftmost 5 digits of GEOID 12099), considering only schools that lie inside FEMA floodplain polygons?

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.GFID) AS num_floodplain FROM floodplain AS f JOIN census_tracts AS t ON ST_OVERLAPS(f.geometry, t.geometry) JOIN county AS c ON ST_INTERSECTS(f.geometry, c.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID, 5) = '22073' AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(c.geometry)
note: cần đối chiếu câu hỏi mới phát hiện được

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT h.UNIQUE_ID) AS num_hospitals FROM hospitals AS h JOIN floodplain AS f ON ST_WITHIN(ST_POINT(h.LON, h.LAT), f.geometry) JOIN census_tracts AS t ON ST_WITHIN(h.geometry, t.geometry) WHERE LEFT(t.GEOID, 5) = '48201' AND ST_ISVALID(f.geometry) AND ST_ISVALID(t.geometry)
